# Orlix Session Lessons

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/index.md`, `docs/ontology.md`, the relevant canonical pages, current structured reports, and recent commits before proposing a durable lesson.

- Put stable domain knowledge in the owning object or concept page.
- Put a repeated workflow correction in the narrowest skill, hook, test, or RuleSync source that can enforce it.
- Record the knowledge operation in `docs/log.md` and regenerate `docs/index.md`.
- Keep current status, command transcripts, failures, and remaining tasks out of documentation.
- Do not turn one conversation into broad policy without repository evidence.
- Do not duplicate canonical architecture facts across skills and object pages.
